name: Sweden

findings.local_actor: Swedish Post and Telecom Authority (PTS); 5G auction bidders
findings.reversal_of: Huawei and ZTE equipment in Swedish mobile networks (central functions and new 5G installations)
findings.summary: PTS barred Huawei and ZTE equipment from new 5G use by auction winners and required existing central-function equipment to be removed by January 2025; Sweden's highest administrative court let the auction proceed in January 2021.
findings.analyst_inference: Reversal of installed Huawei/ZTE equipment, so tier 5 is the tier of the thing reversed. Coded geopolitical: the exclusion followed security-service advice. Huawei's separate appeals against the condition itself were still pending in January 2021; their outcome and whether removal was completed by the 2025 deadline were not checked in this pass.

findings.summary: Net4Mobility picked Nokia, alongside Ericsson, for its 5G radio rollout under a five-year deal, replacing incumbent Huawei 4G gear; Telia uses Nokia as sole 5G standalone core supplier in Sweden.
findings.analyst_inference: Nokia is Finnish, so pole third. Value not disclosed. The Telia core element rests on Light Reading only.

findings.summary: Ericsson supplies Telia's Swedish 5G radio network and was named with Nokia as a 5G RAN partner by Net4Mobility after the January 2021 spectrum auction.
findings.analyst_inference: Ericsson is Swedish, so pole domestic. Hi3G Access (Tre) reportedly ran a Huawei/ZTE mix in its RAN; its replacement vendor was not identified in this pass.

findings.summary: Berzelius, an Nvidia DGX SuperPOD of 60 DGX A100 systems delivered by Atos, went online at Linköping University, funded by a EUR 29.5m Knut and Alice Wallenberg Foundation donation.
findings.analyst_inference: Equipment rule: controller is the accelerator vendor (Nvidia), so pole us; Atos (France) recorded as builder/integrator. Donation value left out of USD fields (EUR source; DCD gives about US$35m). Current operation not re-checked; an AI Business headline indicates a later Nvidia upgrade.

findings.local_actor: Sferical AI (Ericsson, AstraZeneca, Saab, SEB, Wallenberg Investments; SKF strategic partner)
findings.summary: Sferical One, an Nvidia DGX SuperPOD built on DGX GB300 systems, has run since late summer 2026 and was officially launched in October 2026 by a consortium of Swedish industrial firms; services will build on Nvidia Nemotron models.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole us under the equipment rule (Nvidia hardware and software stack); the facility owner is a domestic consortium. System count, value and physical site not stated. still_current true because sources a week old report it running.

findings.local_actor: Microsoft data centres in Sandviken, Gävle and Staffanstorp
findings.summary: Microsoft announced SEK 33.7bn (about US$3.2bn) over two years to expand cloud and AI capacity at its three Swedish data centres, including more than 20,000 GPUs, plus AI skills training.
findings.analyst_inference: Tier 1 because only the investment commitment is evidenced; the three existing sites are operational but completion of the expansion was not checked. USD figure as given by DCD. GPU model not disclosed, so no separate silicon finding.

findings.local_actor: Strängnäs AI data centre (with Swedish government and authorities)
findings.summary: Canada's Brookfield announced up to SEK 95bn (about US$10bn) for an AI data centre at Strängnäs near Stockholm, planned at up to 750 MW over a 10-15 year build, with a land allocation agreement to be signed.
findings.analyst_inference: Brookfield is Canadian, so pole third (owner-operator). Tier 1: announced plan, no construction start reported. Tenants and chip vendor unknown. Current status as of October 2026 not checked.

findings.controller: AI Sweden (with RISE and WASP WARA Media & Language)
findings.summary: GPT-SW3, a family of Nordic-language generative models from 126M to 40B parameters built by AI Sweden and partners, was openly released in November 2023; access is now limited to European researchers on application.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole domestic: weights held by AI Sweden. Trained from scratch, not fine-tuned, so base_model null; Nvidia's blog says training used Berzelius (SWE-004) and Nvidia NeMo Megatron, so the compute and framework are US. Tier 5 reflects release, not evidence of broad adoption; open download has since been withdrawn.

applications.null_reason: one search on Hikvision/Chinese surveillance cameras in Swedish authorities returned only UK, Danish and Irish cases; no Swedish safe-city or police procurement found

power.null_reason: no AI/data-centre-specific power evidence surfaced; budget spent on other layers

research_gaps: Outcome of Huawei's 2020 appeals against the PTS licence condition (Administrative Court in Stockholm) and any later ruling.
Did Telia, Net4Mobility and Hi3G complete Huawei/ZTE removal by the January 2025 deadline? Which vendor replaced Hi3G (Tre)'s Huawei/ZTE RAN?
Is Berzelius still in service, and what did its later Nvidia upgrade add?
Status of Brookfield's Strängnäs campus (land agreement, permits, construction start, anchor tenant) and of Microsoft's 20,000-GPU expansion.

Any Swedish government or agency partnership with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral or others; whether any Stargate-type project is planned in Sweden (searches surfaced only Stargate Norway, reportedly suspended in April 2026).
Chinese-made CCTV (Hikvision/Dahua) use by Swedish municipalities or agencies.
